url.description: A full YouTube watch or share URL. The id is extracted from it, so use this OR `video-id`, not both.

video-id.description: The 11-character YouTube id — the `v=` value in a watch URL. Use this OR `url`.

controls.description: Show YouTube's own player controls. Without them the video can only be driven by script.

autoplay.description: Begin playing on load. Needs `muted`, since browsers block autoplay with sound.

muted.description: Start with audio silenced. Required for `autoplay` to be permitted.

loop.description: Restart from the beginning when playback ends.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
